北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京多云，体感 3℃ 较凉，风力 3级 需添衣保暖，注意补水哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy and feels cool at 3℃. Remember to dress warmly and stay hydrated!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感 4℃ 有些凉意，别忘了多穿一件衣裳。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is overcast and feels a bit cool at 4℃. Don't forget an extra layer!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感 4℃ 略冷，记得及时添衣，别着凉哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast and feels a bit chilly at 4℃. Remember to add clothes and avoid catching a cold.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云，体感 19℃ 舒适宜人，外出心情也要美美的！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and feels comfortable at 19℃. Enjoy your time outdoors!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感 16℃ 暖洋洋，早晚温差大，注意调整着装。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and feels warm at 16℃. Mind the temperature difference between morning and evening.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 3℃ 寒凉，出行要注意防寒保暖哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is overcast and feels quite cold at 3℃. Remember to stay warm when you go out!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 4℃ 微凉，注意多穿一点，别感冒了。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is overcast and feels slightly cool at 4℃. Remember to dress a bit warmer to avoid a cold.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 9℃ 稍凉，记得添衣，喝杯热茶暖暖身。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast and feels a bit cool at 9℃. Remember to add clothes and have a warm tea.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 6℃ 略显凉意，早晚温差大，注意保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is overcast and feels a bit cool at 6℃. Mind the temperature difference between morning and evening.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感 6℃ 稍凉，记得多穿衣，注意皮肤补水。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and feels a bit cool at 6℃. Remember to dress warmly and hydrate your skin.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 9℃ 略有湿冷，记得添衣，保持温暖。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast and feels a bit damp and cold at 9℃. Remember to add clothes and stay warm.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，体感 -18℃ 极寒，请务必全副武装，注意防冻！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy and feels extremely cold at -18℃. Please bundle up and protect yourself from frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -18℃ | 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，体感 -6℃ 寒冷，出门记得穿厚实些，防寒。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and feels cold at -6℃. Remember to dress warmly when going out to keep warm.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 12℃ 微凉，风力 3级，风大注意保暖哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and feels a bit cool at 12℃ with 3-level wind. Remember to keep warm due to the wind.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，体感 12℃ 舒适，湿度 72%，注意防潮。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is overcast and feels comfortable at 12℃, with 72% humidity. Be mindful of moisture.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有霾，体感 0℃ 湿冷，出行请务必做好防护，注意保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao has haze and feels damp and cold at 0℃. Please take precautions and stay warm when going out.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 -4℃ 寒冷，风力 3级，务必多穿防风衣物。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and feels cold at -4℃ with 3-level wind. Be sure to wear windproof clothing.
